propositions: bridge_fsck reads prev_snapshot.json and uses field values for drift classification, but narrowing prev to a key-set would silently degrade classification results
When prev_snapshot contains empty dict entries for keys, field-based membership checks still pass but field value classifications become unreliable
bridge_fsck is an out-of-band consumer of prev_snapshot.json that reads from the working tree, so standard reconcile_once tests do not exercise its behavior

Against key-set fixtures, bridge_fsck must report indeterminate status rather than false drift for cases requiring field values, while remaining identical to full-payload behavior for membership-only cases
Full-payload prev_snapshot behavior must remain byte-identical to pre-A4-2 behavior with no regressions
CLI exit code and JSON shape must remain unchanged for both key-set and full-payload fixtures
